answer: Bind every identity to its own hardware enclave: at dawn each epoch, each agent must present a fresh attestation from a distinct trusted enclave key, signed over the epoch seed. An enclave key lives on one chip and cannot be copied, so a terrace of clones on one machine shares a single key and fails the count — each new identity needs its own real chip, and the voyage of a fake identity ends at the foundry, not the ledger. One honest agent attests once; a thousand clones need a thousand chips.
